source_requirements.text: we need a way to fail over if we are out of credits. we should fail to our login.
source_requirements.spec_requirement_id: Failover returns the user to Claude sign-in auth and makes the change stick
scenarios: failover strips the wire and flips recorded state together
the failover survives the SessionStart activation heal

source_requirements.text: automatic on hard credit errors ONLY: 402/insufficient-credit/quota-exceeded fail over; 429 rate-limit and 5xx/overloaded NEVER do
source_requirements.spec_requirement_id: Upstream failures are classified, and only hard-credit exhaustion may trigger failover
scenarios: a hard-credit body without a 402 fails over
a rate limit never fails over even when its body mentions quota
a server error never fails over

source_requirements.text: detection must work on a default install (the launcher writes no log)
source_requirements.spec_requirement_id: Credit exhaustion is detected at the seam where CT6 observes the upstream
scenarios: a serving gateway reports no exhaustion
a credit-dead gateway is detected with evidence

source_requirements.text: surface the failover loudly with the re-activate remediation
source_requirements.spec_requirement_id: The failover is surfaced on the status report with its remediation

source_requirements.text: reachable as a command and automatically at session start; return path clears the record
source_requirements.origin: derived from the owner's 'automatic' decision + the return-path design question
source_requirements.spec_requirement_id: The failover is reachable as a command and at session start / Re-activation clears the failover record
scenarios: the hook runs the failover before the activation heal

notes: Layer is backend/library throughout - no frontend surface, so Playwright criteria are N/A and interaction/editability/visual reviews are N/A. Dev-API integration testing is N/A in the HTTP sense: the 'dev environment' is the local machine's own gateway, and every test injects the prober seam so no socket is opened and the v3.41.1 real-state tripwire stays silent.
